simple.meaning: רוֹהֲגָה (Rôwhăgâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Rohagah , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רוֹהֲגָה (H7303) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 7:34, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רוֹהֲגָה (H7303) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רוֹהֲגָה (H7303) before moving outward to related references.
